issuer: Bharat National Bank, Retail Banking Operations
summary: Your bank requires you to re-verify your identity documents (KYC) to keep your savings account active and prevent withdrawal limits.

actions.task: Submit updated KYC documents at your branch or via the mobile banking app
actions.why_it_matters: Prevent a temporary freeze on debit transactions and withdrawal restrictions

documents_needed: Original Passport or Voter ID or Driving Licence
Self-attested copy of PAN Card (or Form 60)
Recent utility bill (electricity/piped gas not older than 2 months)
if_ignored: Temporary partial freeze on debit transactions and withdrawal restrictions as per regulatory guidelines.
